title: Define frequency, time period, and wavelength

hook.scenario: Agar koi heart monitor ko dekhe, toh usme beeps ek fix time baad aati hain. Aur har wave ki apni ek lambai hoti hai.
hook.question: Sound waves ki lambai aur timing ko hum kin terms mein measure karte hain?

mental_model.intuition: Wavelength ek step ki lambai hai, Time period ek step lene ka time hai, aur Frequency ek second mein kitne steps liye gaye hain, wo hai.
mental_model.description: Jab sound wave chalti hai, toh do lagataar compressions ke beech ki doori ko Wavelength kehte hain. Ek cycle poori hone ka time Time Period hai, aur ek second mein aisi kitni cycles aayi, wo Frequency hai.

explanation:
Sound wave ko describe karne ke liye hum 3 main terms ka use karte hain: **Wavelength**, **Frequency**, aur **Time Period**.

**Wavelength** ($\lambda$): Ek wave ka ek poora cycle jitni distance mein complete hota hai, use wavelength kehte hain. Longitudinal wave mein, do consecutive compressions ya do consecutive rarefactions ke beech ke distance ko wavelength kehte hain. Iski SI unit meter (m) hai.

**Frequency** ($\nu$): Ek second mein kitne complete oscillations ya cycles ban rahe hain, use frequency kehte hain. Agar koi cheez 1 second mein 50 baar vibrate karti hai, toh uski frequency 50 hertz hogi. Iski SI unit Hertz (Hz) hai.

**Time Period** ($T$): Ek complete oscillation poora karne ke liye wave kitna time leti hai, use time period kehte hain. Iski SI unit second (s) hai.

Frequency aur time period aapas mein closely related hain. Formula hai: $T = 1 / \nu$ (ya $\nu = 1 / T$). Yaani frequency jitni zyada hogi, time period utna hi kam hoga.

key_points.title: Wavelength (λ)
key_points.detail: The distance between two consecutive compressions or rarefactions. SI unit is meter (m).

key_points.title: Frequency (ν)
key_points.detail: The number of oscillations per second. SI unit is Hertz (Hz).

key_points.title: Time Period (T)
key_points.detail: The time taken for one complete oscillation. SI unit is second (s).

key_points.title: Relationship
key_points.detail: Frequency and time period are reciprocals: T = 1 / ν

worked_example.problem: A sound wave has a frequency of 200 Hz. What is the time period of this wave?

steps.narration: Hamein frequency di gayi hai, aur time period nikalna hai. Hum reciprocal formula use karenge.
Value put karenge aur solve karenge.

prediction.question: Longitudinal wave mein ek 'wavelength' (λ) ko physically kaise naap sakte hain?
choices: Ek particle ki aage ki maximum movement
Do lagataar compressions (bheed) ke beech ka distance
Awaaz shuru hone se khatam hone tak ka total distance
prediction.explains: Wavelength ek poori cycle ki lambaai hai. Longitudinal wave me ek compression se thik agle compression tak ka distance ek wavelength hota hai.

reflection.prompt: Ek specific particle ko aage-peeche ka ek pura chakar lagane mein jo time lagta hai, use kya kahenge?
reflection.answer: Time Period (T). Aur 1 second mein aise kitne chakar lagte hain, wo uski Frequency (ν) hai.

worked_example.problem: If the time taken for one complete oscillation is 0.02 seconds, what is its frequency?

steps.narration: Is baar time period diya gaya hai, toh hum frequency nikalne ke liye same formula ka reverse order use karenge.
Time ki value daal kar calculate karenge.

common_mistakes.title: Mixing up wavelength and amplitude
common_mistakes.explanation: Wavelength do compressions ke beech ki horizontal distance hoti hai, jabki amplitude mean position se maximum vertical displacement hota hai. Inhe mix mat karo.

oa_questions.question: What are wavelength, frequency, time period and amplitude of a sound wave?
oa_questions.answer: Wavelength is the distance between two consecutive compressions. Frequency is the number of oscillations per second. Time period is the time taken for one complete oscillation.
oa_questions.approach: Define each term with its SI unit.

oa_questions.question: Define time period of a sound wave.
oa_questions.answer: The time taken for one complete oscillation in the density of the medium is called the time period.
